Definition: Outbound link clicks / platform impressions
Window and exclusions: Same platform and reporting window; do not substitute all clicks

Definition: Media spend / outbound clicks
Window and exclusions: Same campaign; EUR and BRL separate

Definition: 1000 * media spend / impressions
Window and exclusions: Same inventory and period

Definition: Measured arriving landing sessions / outbound clicks
Window and exclusions: Diagnostic ratio; no assumed identity match; consent coverage shown

Definition: Eligible landing sessions opening store link / eligible landing sessions
Window and exclusions: Session counted once; returning installed users separately

Definition: Store-reported new installs and redownloads kept separate
Window and exclusions: Store attribution definitions preserved; do not infer unique owners

Definition: First-use journeys with first usable estimate / first-use journeys starting photo attempt
Window and exclusions: Deduplicate journey; cohort has full selected completion window; show unlinked share

Definition: First photo attempts ending in usable estimate / started first photo attempts
Window and exclusions: Timeout and failure count against success; distinguish retry success

Definition: Failed or timed out photo attempts / started photo attempts
Window and exclusions: By failure reason; include abandoned attempts under declared timeout

Definition: Elapsed time from agreed input-start point to usable estimate displayed
Window and exclusions: Completed estimates; report failed and timed out attempts alongside

Definition: Started attempts with usable result within stated promise / all started attempts
Window and exclusions: Start/end fixed; include failures; do not silently start clock after upload

Definition: Recognised results corrected by user / reviewed recognised results
Window and exclusions: Correction is a signal; not complete model accuracy
Decision use: Find confusing matches and category gaps

Definition: Estimate journeys submitting unique enquiry / journeys with usable estimate
Window and exclusions: Same linked path and maturity window; referral bypass analysed separately

Definition: Unique successful submitted opportunities / journeys starting request form
Window and exclusions: Declared window; repeated submission does not add opportunity

Definition: Qualified opportunities / submitted opportunities
Window and exclusions: Written criteria; pending and unresolved separately; mature cohort

Definition: Partner-acknowledged deliveries / intended deliveries
Window and exclusions: Retry deduplication; distinguish fan-out across partners

Definition: Elapsed time from delivery to first substantive response
Window and exclusions: Responded subset with unresolved age and count shown separately
Decision use: Assess service capacity and owner uncertainty

Definition: Delivered opportunities without substantive decision and their age
Window and exclusions: As-of snapshot; pending is not rejection or success

Definition: Opportunities with formal quote / eligible delivered opportunities
Window and exclusions: Full quotation window; unsupported routes excluded explicitly

Definition: Opportunities with policy bound / opportunities receiving formal quote
Window and exclusions: Actual effective cover evidence; cohort maturity and cancellations tracked

Definition: Submitted opportunities with first contractual payable event / submitted opportunities
Window and exclusions: Mature cohort; pending and reasons shown; first event avoids repeat double count

Definition: Attributable acquisition cost / unique qualified opportunities
Window and exclusions: Cohort-aligned; costs include attributable referral and onboarding work

Definition: Attributable acquisition cost / unique payable events
Window and exclusions: Cohort-aligned; media-only CPA reported separately

Definition: All attributable acquisition cost / newly identified distinct owners
Window and exclusions: Never infer owners from anonymous sessions; reactivation separately
Decision use: Connect acquisition to existing owner model

Definition: Earned contractual fees less fee reversals under finance convention
Window and exclusions: Net retained share; premium and insured value excluded; currency separate

Definition: Attributable net earned Objais fees / media spend
Window and exclusions: Cohort and attribution window declared; never use insurer premium

Definition: Net earned fees - delivery variable costs - attributable acquisition costs
Window and exclusions: Include free and failed use costs; fixed overhead separate

Definition: Value of fees reversed / gross earned fees in matched earned cohort
Window and exclusions: Report event-count rate separately; adequate reversal maturity

Definition: Actual money received allocated to fee/invoice
Window and exclusions: Receipts are collections of fees; not additional earned revenue

Definition: Time from fee earning to allocated collection
Window and exclusions: Collected subset plus unpaid balance/age shown; partial payments retained

Definition: Activated identified owners with defined later task in window / activated owners eligible for window
Window and exclusions: Suggested D30 window days 21-30; label definition; login alone excluded

Definition: Owners with genuinely new payable opportunity / eligible acquired owners
Window and exclusions: Contract-defined new opportunity; visit or scan is not reset

Definition: Eligible due policies renewed / eligible policies reaching renewal due date
Window and exclusions: Mature due cohort; separate contractual remuneration rights

Definition: Participants correctly explaining estimate and cover status / assessed participants
Window and exclusions: Qualitative task sample; denominator and question recorded; no population estimate

Definition: Task attempts completed correctly without help / assessed task attempts
Window and exclusions: Per task and participant; retain assist/failure reason

Definition: LCP <=2.5s; INP <=200ms; CLS <=0.1 at p75
Window and exclusions: Field evidence; mobile/desktop separate; native app excluded

Definition: Outcomes lacking permitted upstream linkage / all outcomes
Window and exclusions: By outcome type and route; no identity guessing

Definition: Operational or finance outcomes not reconciled to canonical records
Window and exclusions: Daily and mature cohort; record causes; avoid hiding vendor modelling difference
